domain_hint: CFD of an APU S-duct intake with perimeter bleed in Fluent vs wind-tunnel rig data
ambiguity_notes:
- Discretization/near-wall treatment: claims of y+<1 low-Re SST versus logs showing y+=45–80 with wall functions
- Geometry/bleed modeling: slide says porous-jump for production while another slide says slots resolved in production meshes
- Turbulence model usage: one slide states all production used SST; another says SA was chosen for production
- Boundary conditions: stated TI=5% and bleed=3% for validation versus records showing TI=1% and bleed=5% in runs
- Software/configuration: declared Fluent 2023 R1 double precision throughout versus logs showing 2022 R2 and single precision on some cases
- Validation results: summary claims PR within 1% across matrix while detailed case shows 4.7% error at α=6°
- Applicability: context slide limits to M≤0.4, α≤8°, while validation slide references use up to M=0.7, α=15° without evidence
